lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I cannot authorize that.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The Outer Rim's partition cannot be opened at an individual's discretion.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It's the closest one to us! We can use it to evacuate these people!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: The Outer Rim doesn't have much electricity, so it'd be a safe zone against the crystals.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I will list the potential problems of opening of the Outer Rim partition without authorization:

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: First, the illegal escape of those residing in the Outer—

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: If that's all you have to say, I'm hanging up!
*Click*
Anis keeps running.
She's distanced herself from the crystals, enough to be safe.
However, there is no guarantee that they'll only spread in one direction.
Anis speeds up and joins the crowd gathering in the plaza.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Hey, I'm here! Where is everyone?!

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Anis! Over here!

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: You're safe. You said you had stuff to do? How'd it go?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I think it's gonna work out. Somehow, at least.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Hey, look over there.
Anis looks to where Avistar is pointing. A giant concrete wall is blocking the exit leading out of the plaza.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Those nutjobs really did it... I can't believe they even got that thing here.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I bet Enikk was behind it.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yeah, they can't let these crystals spread across the rest of the Ark.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: ... So they're leaving us here to die.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Pretty much. We've been kicked to the curb.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Good news is, there's a place for people like us, and that's where we're going.
Avistar turns her head and looks around.
Buildings encircle the plaza on all sides,
their lights flickering.
A wide road extends from the plaza and connects to a tunnel.
At the tunnel entrance is a sign carefully styled to blend in with the surroundings.
Its message, however, is chilling: "Warning: Outer Rim Partition. Enter at your own peril."

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Anis, that's too dangerous.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: There's no way Enikk would allow it.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I don't care. I'm going.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I don't want to die here.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: You haven't thought about anything after that, have you?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Okay. I'll lead the civilians and move—
*Clink, clink, clink!*

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Agghh! It's coming from the sides too!
Crystals burst up from the buildings encircling the plaza. The ground rumbles.
Anis shouts as loud as she can.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Everyone! Follow me!
She then starts running.
Behind her are screams, cries, panic-stricken voices, footsteps, and the relentless sound of the crystals expanding.
The sounds grow louder as she enters the tunnel.
Anis glances back.
Everyone's eyes are fixed on her.
She quickly faces forward.
Mint and Prika follow close beside her.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: I can't believe this is happening!

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: I don't want to die before the concert! What if I turn into a ghost that haunts people?!

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Oh, that'd be the worst! I'd rather die than become a ghost!

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: Well, if you don't die, you don't have to worry about it.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Wh-what if I made the wrong decision...?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What if the partition doesn't open? Can it even be opened?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Is it safe in the Outer Rim? If we do get in, will the people there accept us?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Did I overplay my hand? Would someone else have made a better call...?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I should've just stayed quiet. If I had—
*Tap*
Mint lightly taps Anis's lips with her finger.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Oof.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Snap out of it, Anis.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: All these people are counting on you. Don't second guess yourself.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Right! Sorry!

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: Up ahead. The gate's closing.
At the end of the tunnel, the entrance is slowly closing.
The light pouring into the tunnel slowly begins to fade.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: What? Seriously?

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: That's just mean...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Agh...
Anis grits her teeth and charges forward.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Ahhh!!
Just as the gate is about to close, she leaps toward it.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You... freaking...!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Ark bastards!
*Boom!*
Anis kicks the door and sends it flying.
On the other side of the tunnel,
they are blocked by a towering grey partition, denying passage to all.
Anis keeps running.
Two unmanned guard drones spot her.
They start to blare warning messages.
She slides to the ground, gets into position,
and blasts them with her launcher.
With a loud explosion, the robots burst into smithereens.
Turrets at the top of the partition aim at Anis.
She ducks and sprints for the gate.
*Thud!*
One of the turrets drops beside Anis.
She looks up.
Jackal waves with a smile from atop the wall.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Hehe! Howdy, Anis!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Hey there, terrorists! Nice to see you!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: We'll handle the turrets up here! You take care of the gate.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Got it!
Anis stops in front of the partition.
The massive iron gate is shut tight.
Anis kicks the gate, but it refuses to budge.
She backs up, creating some space, then leaps forward and kicks. The gate still doesn't budge.
She pulls out her launcher, aims, and puts her finger on the trigger.
A chill runs through her.
Suddenly there's a flash, and Anis dives to the side,
just in time to see a neatly carved, scorching hole in the gate.
She turns to see Eternity standing with a blank expression on her face.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Liveryn. Grab that side.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: H-here?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Yeah. We're going to open the gate manually. You'll have to pull it with everything you've got.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: G-got it.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Here we go!
*Thud*
Something lands behind E.H.
Jackal and Viper drop down, their faces pale as they stare at her.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Sh-she's here! She's here! She came!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I figured she would, but didn't think it'd be this soon.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Eeek!
Endless appears in front of E.H.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: You are hereby under arrest on charges of terrorism against the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Be advised that resistance may result in the use of lethal force.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: We have to open this. Or were you just going to kill everyone here?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The consequences of opening the partition are impossible to predict.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The Outer Rim populace could potentially flood into the Ark.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Why the hell would they do that when the other side is infested with crystals?!

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: To cite the previous terrorist attack on the Ark as an example, some individuals crossed the partition even in the middle of a Rapture invasion.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Said individuals were promptly shot down by either Raptures or Central Government forces.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: This illustrates that the Outer Rim populace is unpredictable in their behavior. Even I cannot anticipate their actions.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: They could carry E2 Crystal fragments into the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Thus, the risk is too high.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Do you even hear yourself...?!
Anis glances back.
Countless eyes, full of fear, are fixed on her and Eternity.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Fine...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: If talking isn't going to solve this, I know what will!
Anis lunges at Eternity.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Greetings.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Enikk...?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That is correct. It has been some time since we last conversed, Elysion Harper.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: We need to open the partition.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: You are currently suspected of activating the E2 Crystals in the area commonly known as Punk Street.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Surrender peacefully and comply with our instructions.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: If I told you I didn't do it, would you believe me?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: A judgment will be reached after the facts are established.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Also, you are acting alongside Liveryn, a known fugitive from the Rehabilitation Center who stole the head of Hammering from the Hammer and Drill Squad.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: This significantly lowers your credibility.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: The great ruler of the Ark, here to talk in person? The situation must be grim.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: For the Ark, at least.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Do you think we'll have to fight her?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Probably?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Ugh...! I'm scared of her...

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Right? Me too.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I'm going to open the partition. Tell Endless and Eternity to move aside, Enikk.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That is not possible.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: You know as well as I do that the Outer Rim is relatively safe from the E2 Crystals.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Why aren't you considering that as an option?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I do not consider it as an option because the Outer Rim is not the Ark.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Wow...

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: So, what, the Outer Rim is just the Ark's dumpster?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Then what do you think of the people living here?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: They chose to live in the Outer Rim of their own free will.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: It is no different from renouncing Ark citizenship.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: They never had a choice!

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: No one lives in this forsaken place because they want to.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Attempting to persuade me is futile.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Leader, how long are we going to keep talking? Don't we have things to do?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Yeah! I'm not entirely sure what's going on, but we've gotta open this door!

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: ... Yeah, you're right.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text:
Everyone, get ready. 
We're going to fight Endless.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: D-does that include me?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Find a good hiding spot.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Oh, and don't even think of running away. Not again.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Let's go.
Outside the partition...
Anis is getting overwhelmed by Eternity,
who deflects every single one of her attacks.
Meanwhile, Eternity swings her arms and legs seemingly at random.
While far from graceful, her attacks are nonetheless quick and powerful.
Anis tumbles across the ground before barely managing to force herself upright.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Urgh...!

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Anis!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Stay away! You'll just get in the way!
*Clink, clink, clink!*
The sound of the crystals getting nearer echoes from within the tunnel.
People are panicking but are unable to move forward,
frozen in place due to Eternity's sheer aggression.
Anis turns around.
Everyone is looking at her.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Open... the gate!
Anis charges forward, but Eternity swats her aside.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I said... open it...!

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Your request is impossible to grant.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Arrrrrghhh!
Anis charges again, and Eternity once again sends her flying.
She slams into the tunnel wall.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Agghh!
Anis stares at the wall as she pushes herself up, her body trembling.
The crystals are already breaking through.
Anis messes with her phone.
She then wipes the blood from her lips and charges in again.
Eternity begins to pummel her. Anis struggles to stay conscious, but she grits her teeth and endures it.
With her phone in hand, she takes a swing at Eternity's face.
*Thud*
Eternity catches her arm.
Both her phone and her own hand have crystals protruding from them.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I can predict your every move.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: *Spit*
Anis spits out a mouthful of crystals.
They strike Eternity in the cheek.
Anis grins, revealing a mouth mangled by crystals.
*Clink, clink, clink!*
Crystals spread rapidly across Eternity's body.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I... win...

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Core shutdown.
Eternity slumps down.
The crystals, deprived of their food, crumble to dust.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Rebooting.
*Buzzzz*

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Forcing reconnection to damaged section.
*Crack, craaaack!*

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Reconnection complete.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You're... kidding...

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Are those people behind you friends of yours?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Are they important to you?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Some, yeah, but I don't know most of them.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: A few of them even hate me.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Then why go to such extremes for their sake?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Aren't you the one who said Nikkes need to protect humans?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Based on your prior actions and statements, this does not align with your ideology.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I do not understand your actions.
Anis turns around.
The crowd gazes upon her.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I don't know...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Maybe everything I've been doing switched me back into popstar mode.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Meaning unclear.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You see,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: pop stars have to live up to the public's expectations.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Whenever I went on stage... well, "stage" might be too grand a word, but anyway.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Everyone would be looking at me,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: their eyes full of anticipation.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: When that would happen, I'd do whatever it takes,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: anything for those people looking to me!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: They're counting on me, and I can't let them down!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Look! Even now!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: They're all looking at me!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I have to do something...!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I can't just turn away from them!
A flash of light bursts from Eternity's hand.
A massive hole pierces the partition.
Anis stares blankly at the hole.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What... the...?
Beyond the hole floats Endless. Beneath her lay the fallen members of Exotic.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: E.H.?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Eternity, why did you make a hole in the gate?
Eternity stares at Anis intently.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Initiating maintenance. Analyzing the cause of anomalous behavior.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Confirming breach of partition entrance.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Adjusting plan.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Relocate all personnel near the partition to the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Wh... What?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The deed is done. We must revise the plan quickly and respond accordingly.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Once all individuals have entered the Outer Rim, I will explain the next phase of the plan.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Proceed swiftly.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Ugh, you are unbelievable...!
*Clink!*
Anis feels a disturbing pain in her mouth and arm.
The crystals are spreading.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: This is bad...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Mint! Prika! Avistar!

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: How can we help?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Take care of these people.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: There's something I need to do over there.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Is something wrong, Anis?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yeah. Something is.
Anis walks toward the opposite side of the partition.
She realizes she'll be in serious trouble if the crystals continue to spread through her body.
While the Outer Rim likely won't have much electricity for them, she knows anything could happen.
What if she got unlucky and stepped on a live wire?
Or if someone touched her while carrying electronics?
The Outer Rim would cease to be a safe place for everyone else.
Anis continues walking toward the other side of the partition.
Meanwhile, the others sprint for the gate, glancing at her as they pass.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Heh...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: This is why I hate cleaning up after others.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What do I get for it? Nothing... Nothing but trouble.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: *Sigh*

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I hate it. I really do.
Suddenly Anis feels something grip her head.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Huh...?
Eternity is holding onto her.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What, you wanna go another round? Sorry, but I don't have time...

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Eternity. Go back to your position.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: ... Confirming refusal to obey. Initiating cause analysis.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Wh-what?! This is starting to creep me out.
*Whoosh*
Anis's vision goes black.
